mapper.select: SELECT image_name FROM image WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND is_public = 1 ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 30
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image (image_name, is_public, is_deleted, image_contents, image_date, image_reg_date, coord_point_id, user_id) VALUES (#{imageName}, #{isPublic}, #{isDeleted}, #{imageContent}, #{imageDate}, #{imageRegDate}, #{coordPoint.coordinatePointId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, cp.*, sgg.sgg_id, sgg.sgg_name, sd.sd_id, sd.sd_name FROM image i LEFT JOIN coord_poi cp ON i.coord_point_id = cp.coord_point_id LEFT JOIN juso_sigungu sgg ON cp.sgg_id = sgg.sgg_id LEFT JOIN juso_sido sd ON sgg.sd_id = sd.sd_id WHERE i.image_id = #{imageId} AND i.is_deleted = 0

SELECT i.image_id as imageId, i.user_id as userId, i.image_name as imageName FROM image i WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_deleted = 0
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM album_image ai WHERE ai.image_id = i.image_id AND ai.album_id = #{excludeAlbumId} )

SELECT i.image_id, i.image_name, i.is_public, i.is_deleted, i.image_contents, i.image_date, i.image_reg_date, i.user_id, cp.coord_point_id, cp.coord_point_name, cp.coord_point_detail, cp.coord_point_point, cp.coord_point_type, cp.first_reg_dt, cp.last_mod_dt, sgg.sgg_id, sgg.sgg_name, sd.sd_id, sd.sd_name FROM image i JOIN coord_poi cp ON i.coord_point_id = cp.coord_point_id JOIN juso_sigungu sgg ON cp.sgg_id = sgg.sgg_id JOIN juso_sido sd ON sgg.sd_id = sd.sd_id WHERE sgg.sd_id = #{sidoId} AND i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY i.image_reg_date DESC

SELECT i.image_id, i.image_name, i.is_public, i.is_deleted, i.image_contents, i.image_date, i.image_reg_date, i.user_id, cp.coord_point_id, cp.coord_point_name, cp.coord_point_detail, cp.coord_point_point, cp.coord_point_type, cp.first_reg_dt, cp.last_mod_dt, sgg.sgg_id, sgg.sgg_name, sd.sd_id, sd.sd_name FROM image i JOIN coord_poi cp ON i.coord_point_id = cp.coord_point_id JOIN juso_sigungu sgg ON cp.sgg_id = sgg.sgg_id JOIN juso_sido sd ON sgg.sd_id = sd.sd_id WHERE cp.sgg_id = #{sigunguId} AND i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY i.image_reg_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE image SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE image_id = #{imageId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: WITH sido_coverage AS ( SELECT sd.sd_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sgg.sgg_id) as total_sgg_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.image_id IS NOT NULL THEN sgg.sgg_id END) as image_sgg_count FROM juso_sido sd JOIN juso_sigungu sgg ON sd.sd_id = sgg.sd_id LEFT JOIN coord_poi c ON sgg.sgg_id = c.sgg_id LEFT JOIN image i ON c.coord_point_id = i.coord_point_id AND i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY sd.sd_id ) SELECT sd_id FROM sido_coverage WHERE image_sgg_count > 0 AND image_sgg_count < total_sgg_count

WITH sido_coverage AS ( SELECT sd.sd_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sgg.sgg_id) as total_sgg_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.image_id IS NOT NULL THEN sgg.sgg_id END) as image_sgg_count FROM juso_sido sd JOIN juso_sigungu sgg ON sd.sd_id = sgg.sd_id LEFT JOIN coord_poi c ON sgg.sgg_id = c.sgg_id LEFT JOIN image i ON c.coord_point_id = i.coord_point_id AND i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY sd.sd_id ) SELECT sd_id FROM sido_coverage WHERE image_sgg_count = total_sgg_count AND total_sgg_count > 0

SELECT DISTINCT sgg.sgg_id FROM image i JOIN coord_poi cp ON i.coord_point_id = cp.coord_point_id JOIN juso_sigungu sgg ON cp.sgg_id = sgg.sgg_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_deleted = 0 AND sgg.sd_id = #{sidoId}
